name: Morishita Saeko
source:
A nurse who, like Sayaka and Miyako, ends up working at “Date Clinic.” While she is a flawless nurse, patients tend to find her a bit intimidating, perhaps due to her somewhat harsh personality.

In fact, she has a history of being made a scapegoat for a patient’s death caused by medical malpractice at a previous hospital, which led to her being forced to resign.

The protagonist holds this weakness over her.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/9184/?gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
